stdout:
List captions. Use this tool to list captions of a video.

Usage:
  yutu caption list [flags]

Examples:
# List captions of a video
yutu caption list --videoId dQw4w9WgXcQ
# List captions in JSON format
yutu caption list --videoId dQw4w9WgXcQ --output json
# List specific captions by IDs
yutu caption list --ids abc123,def456 --videoId dQw4w9WgXcQ

Flags:
  -h, --help                            help for list
  -i, --ids strings                     IDs of the captions to list
  -b, --onBehalfOf string               ID of the YouTube account that the content owner is acting on behalf of
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -o, --output string                   json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings                   Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet])
  -v, --videoId string                  ID of the video
